bullets.text: In Arambakkam, Thiruvallur, a woman attempted suicide with her children demanding the return of her second husband, and the office should monitor her well-being.
In Thiruttani, four devotees sustained serious injuries when temple tower stones fell on them while waiting for darshan, and authorities must ensure emergency medical care.
Untreated sewage near the Pattabiram railway station degraded borewell water, raising health concerns for residents, and local teams should coordinate cleanup.

Improvement works are intense in Porur ahead of the Prime Minister and Chief Minister visits for the Metro rail service launch, requiring local oversight.
Power supply will be suspended in parts of Chennai for maintenance work, and the office should watch for public inconvenience.
A wanted criminal from Athipattu in Minjur has a pending case at the Thiruvallur railway station police, and law enforcement should expedite action.
Thiruttani municipality imposed a 5,000 rupee fine for garbage dumping in public places under the solid waste management plan, and officials should ensure compliance.
Thiruvallur district collector Kavitha announced November 15 as the deadline for paddy crop insurance, and the agriculture team should assist farmers.
India's data center capacity growth is creating high demand for non-software roles like electrical and cooling, and the portfolio team should support skill development.
Meta's AI data center expansion highlights specific corporate tax strategies, and the digital services team should monitor related industry trends.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Ilaiyaraaja Music Research Centre at IIT Madras during his visit, and the office should coordinate the event preparations.
